description: Central Provincial Council  - Statute of Digana Sports Complex and the Sports Development Foundation of the Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new provincial statute ("Digana Sports Complex and the Sports Development Foundation of the Central Provincial Council Statute No. 02 of 2018") that establishes a legal framework for sports administration and development. It creates a statutory body with legal powers, outlines its objectives, governance structure, powers, and duties. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework establishment under provincial authority, rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
